component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.letters.operations
component.documentation: Letter.Generate: a letter written on a record, from its letter's template, as the person who asks, who must hold Write on the record. A button runs it only through a chain of the kit's that the deployment's allow-list names and that begins with AgenticUi.RequireRunAction (decision 3); Nuxeo's own Automation endpoint reaches it too, for anyone, and the operation's own checks are the control either way. No REST binding is contributed.
